The silver wire connecting the beads in the upper right curve appears to vanish or merge into the beads without clear structural continuity, a common artifact in AI-generated jewelry where thin connectors fail to render consistently.
The geometry of the clasp in the upper left is slightly ambiguous; the hinge and latch mechanism do not align perfectly with standard physical clasps, appearing slightly melted or ill-defined.
